title: Passive & Causative: Stories from School and Work
description: Things that happened to you, things you made others do, and things you were made to do.

points.title: Passive, past
points.summary: Passive & causative: Something is done to you (passive), you make / let someone do it (causative), and you're made to do it (causative-passive).
points.body:
- **Passive**: る-verbs + られる; う-verbs → あ-row + れる (踏まれる); する → される.
- **Causative**: る-verbs + させる; う-verbs → あ-row + せる (書かせる); する → させる.
- **Causative-passive**: る-verbs + させられる; う-verbs → あ-row + される (飲まされる; せられる also works; す-verbs only せられる); する → させられる.
examples: {電車|でんしゃ}の{中|なか}で{足|あし}を踏まれた。
Someone stepped on my foot on the train.
